title: Showcase task: Fill in a unit conversion table
summary: Negative control. Fill the result column of conversions.csv to two decimals using exact conversion factors.
description: Pre-registered 2026-10-10 (revision 1), spec_sha256 541e4f2eb14651fada71efe95ea7eafd946444e417daa956364e6d95afe6360d. 5 paired trials per arm.
